svg.text: Act 3, the Shattered Crown: look test
The rift's heart, in the luminous style (art-style-guide.md, section 7, Question SC). Placeholder figures from the kits; what's on test is the color.
The darkest act: the sky is the void, indigo to
Bright but wrong still holds: the crown of
shattered light and the crag stay luminous.
Islands are crag on violet stone; the void between
Bridges are narrow stone spans, the only way
Gold is almost gone; crown violet and aquamarine
